card.name: Linking words before supportive treatment
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word parts (with, of, a comma, -ous) just before a supportive or rescue treatment such as oxygen, transfusion, pacing or hormone replacement. Seen in management and overdose passages.

modes.label: Treated with
modes.description: The word 'with' after treated or manage, leading into a supportive therapy.
modes.example: 37% of patients were treated<< with>> thyroid hormone replacement.

modes.label: Pacing wording
modes.description: Partway through 'transvenous' or after heart block, just before pacemaker or pacing.
modes.example: transthoracic or transven<<ous>> pacemaker placement may be necessary.

modes.label: Of before support item
modes.description: The word 'of' after transfusion or placement, leading into blood products or a pacemaker.
modes.example: Supportive care, including transfusion<< of>> blood products and other medical management, may
